verdict.rationale: Airweave is open-source and self-hostable (git clone, ./start.sh) and exposes an API/CLI for search, but the evidence pack contains no mention of a data export feature, open-format export, or documented way to bulk-extract synced data to leave the platform. Self-hosting and API access are adjacent but do not substitute for an explicit export capability. Missing for 10: documented export/download functionality, open data format guarantees, and any migration/exit tooling.
